content.text: A single locked-off first-person shot of Gou An resting on his rope bed, exactly matching the supplied first frame: same face, clothes, pose, lighting and location. Only this one man remains in the frame throughout. His arms stay resting in their starting position. He looks toward the camera and speaks Mandarin naturally, once: “那你何必还来问我。要怎么做，你自己定。” Then his lips close. Keep the original composition for the entire shot, with subtle breathing and small eye movements. No other person enters, no new objects enter, no cuts, no camera movement, no subtitles, no music. Soft tent ambience only apart from the specified dialogue.
